course.name: PM Workbench Course
course.description: Set up PM Workbench and take one objective through the full PM Journey, from signal to retro, with Claude as your guide.

lessons.title: Welcome and choose your track
lessons.description: What PM Workbench is, how the course works, and which track fits you

modules.name: Setup
modules.description: Get the workbench running against your Jira, or against demo data

lessons.title: Prerequisites and first run
lessons.description: Python, Claude Code, a Jira token, and starting the app (or the demo)

lessons.title: Configure the workbench
lessons.description: Jira connection and fields, the workspace and its skills, first pull, and how the tabs are laid out

lessons.title: Track A: start from scratch
lessons.description: No PRDs or epics yet: write portfolio context, create objectives, capture a first signal

lessons.title: Track B: bring your existing PRDs and epics
lessons.description: Pull epics, bring PRDs into the workspace, link them, and read where each initiative stands

modules.name: Lifecycle of an objective
modules.description: Take one objective from definition to retro

lessons.title: Define the objective and its key results
lessons.description: Write the objective, rank it, give it a parent, add a measurable key result

lessons.title: Signals, ideas and evidence
lessons.description: Inbox: sources, extracted ideas, groups, and the validation score

lessons.title: Discovery: from idea to PRD
lessons.description: pm-guide, discovery, research synthesis, Concept Accept, the PRD, risk review, UX brief, optional prototype

lessons.title: The PRD gate
lessons.description: review-prd, then validate-prd: what the gate checks, what it decides, and how to recover from FAIL

lessons.title: High-level design
lessons.description: generate-hld, validate-hld and its three verdicts, and when design is skipped

lessons.title: Epics, stories and publishing specs
lessons.description: generate-epics-and-stories, right-sizing, and the optional spec pull request

lessons.title: Requirements Accept and Ready
lessons.description: The story Definition of Ready, creating stories in Jira, and the Ready badge

lessons.title: Prioritize the backlog
lessons.description: Score inputs, rank and bands, evidence weighting, and pushing priorities to Jira with a dry run

lessons.title: Run it week to week
lessons.description: Today as a weekly ritual, KR readings, the decision / risk / blocker log, status reports

lessons.title: Close the loop: retro
lessons.description: Retros on closed epics, KRs at release and after, the verdict, and what feeds the next objective

assistant.title: Guide: what do I do next?
assistant.description: Ongoing assistant. Reads where an objective or initiative stands and coaches the next step.
